messages:
Sam H: heads-up: onboarding HyperNova LoRA adapter into int4 evals. seeing weird numeric token disappearance on invoice prompts. minimal repro below.
Priya N: can you paste the exact prompt that fails?
Sam H: `Invoice #12345: total $1,234.56 ->` sometimes the model emits only 'Invoice #12345: total ' then stops. more likely on long ctx + small batches.
Mike L: is tokenizer mapping 1:1 with base? any new special tokens?
Sam H: tokenizer unchanged. also verified token ids for dollars/commas. KV traces look ok at a glance.
Elaine R: sounds like quant attention instability. did you try disabling fused attention or using a higher-precision kernel?
Sam H: not yet. I ran a quick eval pack: numeric-extraction delta = -5.8% vs fp16, throughput +22%.
Priya N: run this narrow command: `./evals/run_quickpack.sh --model hypernova/lora --quant int4 --suite numeric --batch 1 --ctx 4096 --disable-fused-gemm` and capture `--debug-attn` output.
Mike L: also test `--sampling=greedy` and `--sampling=top_p:0.95` to see if sampling causes collapse. and try `--quant-backend=x64-fallback` if available.
Elaine R: add `--kv-warmup 3` and `--dump-attn-step 10-15` to isolate step where tokens drop. possible clamp/scale missing when folding LoRA into int4 weights.
Sam H: kicked off jobs. deploy-bot triggered CI: `ci/hypernova-int4-eval-912` by @Sam H (docker: inference-eval:canary).
Sam H: logs snippet: ```
[prompt] Invoice #12345: total $1,234.56 ->
[tokenizer] ids: [502, 1298, 45, 67, 321, ...]
[emit] tokens: "Invoice #12345: total "
[reason] stop_reason: eos
[attn] last_layer_max: 2.9e-05
```
Priya N: eos trigger is suspicious. is end-of-sequence token present in input by accident?
Sam H: nope. defaults are clean. temp=0.7 in these runs.
Mike L: try temp=0 (greedy) and check if it still terminates early. also run fp16 baseline to confirm quant-only.
Sam H: fp16 baseline passes. so int4 path is culprit.
Elaine R: use `RUNNER_DEBUG=quant,kernels` to force slow but verbose quant path. capture weight stats before/after LoRA folding: mean/std/min/max.
Sam H: debug run done. traces uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-evals/hypernova/912/traces.tar.gz 
Priya N: grabbing traces. if clamp missed during fold, unit test should cover invoice-like numeric tokens (commas, periods, currency). I'll draft a tiny regression that folds LoRA + quant and asserts no inf/nan and numeric tokens still produced by greedy decode.
Mike L: suggestion: add a runtime fallback in rollout: if numeric-extraction metric drops >3% for a tenant, route them to fp16 model or a safer quant preset. canary int4 to 2% initially.
Elaine R: I'll update the model rollout doc with fallback policy and the diagnostic checklist (tokenizer check, clamp pass, kernel fallback).
Sam H: thanks. once Priya posts the customer-facing quickpack and notebook, I'll share with HyperNova engineering.
deploy-bot: ci/hypernova-int4-eval-912 completed: SUCCESS (artifacts at s3://redwood-evals/hypernova/912)
Priya N: created quickpack artifacts: `quickpack_hypernova_invoice_v1.zip` with 25 invoice prompts, a Jupyter notebook showing repro steps and mitigations, and runnable commands for their infra. uploaded to s3 and linked in the customer doc.
Sam H: moving to open a patch: quant-scaler clamp + unit test. will keep this thread updated. thanks all!
